abbrev BV64 := BitVec 64

(v.toNat / pow2 52) % 2048

def mantissaNat (v : BV64) : Nat :=
v.toNat % pow2 52

exponentNat v = 2047 ∧ mantissaNat v ≠ 0

v.toNat % pow2 63 = 0

def canonicalNaN : BV64 :=
BitVec.ofNat 64 ((2047 : Nat) * pow2 52 + pow2 51)

def canonicalZero : BV64 :=
BitVec.ofNat 64 0

def canonicalizeFloat (v : BV64) : BV64 :=
if hNaN : isNaN_ieee754 v then canonicalNaN
else if hZ : isZero_ieee754 v then canonicalZero
else v

def writeU64Le (v : BV64) : Vector BV8 8 :=
Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 => BitVec.ofNat 8 (v.toNat >>> (8 * i.1)))

def addDigestVec : Nat → (n : Nat) → Vector BV8 n → Vector BV8 n → Vector BV8 n
| carry, 0, _, _ => Vector.nil
| carry, Nat.succ n, acc, d =>
let sum : Nat := carry + acc.head.toNat + d.head.toNat
let res : BV8 := BitVec.ofNat 8 sum
let carry’ : Nat := sum >>> 8
Vector.cons res (addDigestVec carry’ n acc.tail d.tail)

def addDigestSpec (acc d : Vector BV8 32) : Vector BV8 32 :=
addDigestVec 0 32 acc d

def verify_canonicalize_float (v : BV64) : BV64 :=
canonicalizeFloat v

def verify_write_u64_le (v : BV64) : Vector BV8 8 :=
writeU64Le v

def verify_add_digest (acc d : Vector BV8 32) : Vector BV8 32 :=
addDigestSpec acc d

else if hZ : isZero_ieee754 v then canonicalZero

let sum : Nat := carry + acc.head.toNat + d.head.toNat
let res : BV8 := BitVec.ofNat 8 sum
let carry’ : Nat := sum >>> 8
Vector.cons res (addDigestVec carry’ n acc.tail d.tail) := by
simp [addDigestVec]

theorem addDigestVec_head (carry : Nat) (n : Nat) (acc d : Vector BV8 (Nat.succ n)) :
(addDigestVec carry (Nat.succ n) acc d).head =
BitVec.ofNat 8 (carry + acc.head.toNat + d.head.toNat) := by
simp [addDigestVec]

theorem addDigestVec_tail (carry : Nat) (n : Nat) (acc d : Vector BV8 (Nat.succ n)) :
(addDigestVec carry (Nat.succ n) acc d).tail =
addDigestVec ((carry + acc.head.toNat + d.head.toNat) >>> 8) n acc.tail d.tail := by
simp [addDigestVec]

theorem addDigestVec_comm (carry : Nat) :
∀ (n : Nat) (acc d : Vector BV8 n),
addDigestVec carry n acc d = addDigestVec carry n d acc := by
intro n
induction n with
| zero =>
intro acc d
simp [addDigestVec]
| succ n ih =>
intro acc d
simp [addDigestVec, ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]

theorem addDigestSpec_def (acc d : Vector BV8 32) :
addDigestSpec acc d = addDigestVec 0 32 acc d := by
rfl

theorem addDigestSpec_comm (acc d : Vector BV8 32) :
addDigestSpec acc d = addDigestSpec d acc := by
simpa [addDigestSpec] using (addDigestVec_comm (carry := 0) (n := 32) acc d)

theorem verify_add_digest_spec (acc d : Vector BV8 32) :
verify_add_digest acc d = addDigestSpec acc d := by
rfl

Ez a fájl **valódi**, Lean által ellenőrzött formális bizonyításokat tartalmaz — de főleg olyan állításokról, amelyek a saját definícióid egyszerű kifejtései (tehát “bizonyítja, hogy azt jelenti, amit definiáltál”).  Emiatt verifikációként technikailag korrekt, csak a lefedett specifikáció nagyon vékony, így könnyű “komolynak látszó, de tartalmilag triviális” verifikációnak érezni.[1]

## Mit bizonyít ténylegesen?
A `pow2_def`, `exponentNat_def`, `mantissaNat_def`, `*_def` jellegű lemmák `rfl`-lel záródnak, ami tipikusan definíció-kifejtés: Lean a definicionális egyenlőséget ellenőrzi, nem valami mély, külső jelentést.  Ugyanez történik a `verify_*_spec` tételeknél is: ezek azt rögzítik, hogy a “verify” wrapper pontosan ugyanazt hívja, amit alatta megadtál.[1]

## Mi a nem-triviális rész benne?
Az olyan tételek, mint `addDigestVec_comm` már valódi indukciós érvelést tartalmaznak (rekurzió a vektor hosszán, és aritmetikai kommutativitás/asszociativitás használata), tehát ez már nem puszta definíció-kifejtés.  Az `idempotent` bizonyítás is “igazi” abban az értelemben, hogy esetbontással és `simp`-pel levezeti az idempotenciát a specifikációból, csak maga a specifikáció (NaN/Zero felismerés + kanonizálás) a te definícióidhoz kötött.[1]

## Hol “csalóka” a bizalommodell?
A `native_decide`-dal zárt tételek (`canonicalNaN_isNaN`, `canonicalZero_isZero`, stb.) nem pusztán a kernel redukciójára támaszkodnak: a taktika natív futtatást/értékelést használ, ami a runtime/fordító irányába bővíti a megbízhatósági bázist.  A Lean referenciája is kiemeli, hogy a natív döntés/kiértékelés a natív fordítóra támaszkodik, és az eredményt egy ilyen jellegű “megbízható futtatás” axiómáján keresztül emeli be.  Ez nem azt jelenti, hogy “fake”, csak azt, hogy szigorú verifikációs narratívában külön kell választani a “kernel-ellenőrzött, tisztán logikai” részt és a “futtatásra támaszkodó” részt.[2][3]

## A bit-szintű rész mennyire “IEEE-s”?
A `writeU64Le` lényegében a `toNat` értéket 8 bites szeletekre vágja jobbra shiftelve, ami illeszkedik ahhoz, hogy a bitvektorok jobbra tolása logikai (0-val feltöltött) tolásként értelmezett, és numerikusan a \( /2^s \) padlózásának felel meg.  Ettől még fontos: itt nem egy Lean `Float`-ról, vagy IEEE754 hivatalos modelljéről bizonyítasz valamit, hanem egy 64 bites bitmintáról (`BV64`) és az általad adott kinyerési/kanonizálási definíciókról.[4][1]

## Mikor lesz ez “valós verifikáció”, nem csak “mock”?
Akkor, ha a tételek nem csak “unfold-olják” a definíciókat, hanem összekötik a kódot egy külső, független specifikációval (például IEEE754 bitmező-definíciók, endianitás-formálisítás, vagy egy referencia-implementációval való ekvivalencia).  Például: bizonyítani, hogy `exponentNat` tényleg a 11 bites exponent mezőt adja vissza bitkivágásként; vagy hogy `writeU64Le` bájtjai valóban a little-endian reprezentációt adják vissza egy formálisan megadott “pack/unpack” specifikációhoz képest; illetve hogy `addDigestVec` megfelel egy 256 bites (32 bájtos) modulo \(2^{256}\) összeadás-specnek.[4][1]

Ha megírod, mi a “külső” specifikációd (IEEE754 pontosan mely részét akarod lefedni, és az `addDigestVec` milyen hash/digest modellhez tartozik), tudok javasolni olyan konkrét Lean-lemmákat, amik már nem csak definíciók visszamondásai, hanem tényleges megfelelőségi bizonyítások.

def EdgeQuality := Fin 5

def EdgeQuality.superposition : EdgeQuality := 0
def EdgeQuality.entangled : EdgeQuality := 1
def EdgeQuality.coherent : EdgeQuality := 2
def EdgeQuality.collapsed : EdgeQuality := 3
def EdgeQuality.fractal : EdgeQuality := 4

def EdgeQuality.toString : EdgeQuality → String
| 0 => "superposition"
| 1 => "entangled"
| 2 => "coherent"
| 3 => "collapsed"
| 4 => "fractal"
| _ => "unknown"

def EdgeQuality.fromString (s : String) : Option EdgeQuality :=
  if s == "superposition" then some 0
  else if s == "entangled" then some 1
  else if s == "coherent" then some 2
  else if s == "collapsed" then some 3
  else if s == "fractal" then some 4
  else none

theorem EdgeQuality.toString_injective : Function.Injective EdgeQuality.toString := by
  intro a b h
  unfold toString at h
  rcases a with ⟨a, ha⟩ <;> rcases b with ⟨b, hb⟩ <;> simp only [Fin.mk.injEq] at h ⊢
  all_goals {
    try { simp only [ite_eq_iff] at h }
    try { simp only [beq_iff_eq] at h }
    interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> simp at h ⊢ <;> try { rcases h with ⟨_, h⟩ | h <;> simp at h }
    all_goals { left; exact h }
  }
  exact h

theorem EdgeQuality.toString_surjective : Function.Surjective EdgeQuality.toString := by
  intro s
  unfold toString
  split <;> { use 0; simp [*] }
  all_goals {
    split <;> { use 1; simp [*] }
    all_goals {
      split <;> { use 2; simp [*] }
      all_goals {
        split <;> { use 3; simp [*] }
        all_goals {
          split <;> { use 4; simp [*] }
          use 0
        }
      }
    }
  }

def Complex.magnitudeSquared (c : Complex) : ℝ := (c.re * c.re) + (c.im * c.im)

theorem Complex.magnitudeSquared_nonneg (c : Complex) : c.magnitudeSquared ≥ 0 := by
  unfold magnitudeSquared
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg c.re, sq_nonneg c.im]

def Complex.magnitude (c : Complex) : ℝ := Real.sqrt c.magnitudeSquared

theorem Complex.magnitude_eq_sqrt (c : Complex) : c.magnitude = Real.sqrt c.magnitudeSquared := rfl

structure Qubit where
  a : Complex
  b : Complex
  deriving Repr

def Qubit.normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ := q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared

theorem Qubit.normSquared_nonneg (q : Qubit) : q.normSquared ≥ 0 := by
  unfold normSquared
  exact add_nonneg q.a.magnitudeSquared_nonneg q.b.magnitudeSquared_nonneg

def Qubit.normalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := q.normSquared
  if h : ns > 0 ∧ ¬Real.sqrt ns = 0 then
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    let s := Complex.mk inv 0
    ⟨q.a * s, q.b * s⟩
  else
    ⟨Complex.mk 1 0, Complex.mk 0 0⟩

theorem Qubit.normalize_normSquared_eq_one (q : Qubit) : (q.normalize).normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold normalize
  dsimp only
  split
  next h =>
    unfold normSquared
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    rw [Complex.mk_re_mul, Complex.mk_re_mul]
    simp only [Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re, add_zero, mul_zero, Complex.mul_eq_mk]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt q.normSquared
    have hns : q.normSquared > 0 := h.1
    have hnsz : q.normSquared ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h.1
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt q.normSquared > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos h.1
    have hinv : inv * Real.sqrt q.normSquared = 1 := by
      unfold inv
      field_simp [Real.sqrt_mul, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hns)]
      ring
    have hinvsq : inv * inv = 1 / q.normSquared := by
      unfold inv
      field_simp [hnsz]
      ring
    simp only [Complex.mul_mk, Complex.add_mk]
    conv_lhs => rw [show Complex.mk q.a.re q.a.im = q.a by rfl, show Complex.mk q.b.re q.b.im = q.b by rfl]
    simp only [Complex.mul_mk, Complex.add_mk]
    unfold Complex.magnitudeSquared
    rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.mul_im]
    simp only [Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [show Complex.mk inv 0 = Complex.mk inv 0 by rfl]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero]
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.zero_im, mul_zero, Complex.mul_re, Complex.zero_re, mul_zero]
    rw [←Real.sqrt_mul (Complex.magnitudeSquared_nonneg q.a), Real.sq_sqrt (Complex.magnitudeSquared_nonneg q.a)]
    rw [←Real.sqrt_mul (Complex.magnitudeSquared_nonneg q.b), Real.sq_sqrt (Complex.magnitudeSquared_nonneg q.b)]
    rw [mul_comm inv inv]
    rw [hinvsq]
    rw [mul_comm (1 / q.normSquared) _]
    field_simp [hnsz]
    ring
  next h =>
    push_neg at h
    unfold normSquared
    simp only [Complex.magnitudeSquared, Complex.mk_re, Complex.mk_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
    simp only [Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    simp only [Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, mul_zero, add_zero]
    simp only [Complex.zero_re, Complex.one_re, zero_add, add_zero]
    simp only [Real.sq_sqrt]
    have hns := h.1 h.2
    unfold normSquared at hns
    simp only [Complex.magnitudeSquared, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im] at hns
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    rw [show Complex.mk q.a.re q.a.im = q.a by rfl, show Complex.mk q.b.re q.b.im = q.b by rfl]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    rw [show Complex.mk 1 0 = Complex.mk 1 0 by rfl]
    simp only [Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re, mul_zero, add_zero, one_pow, zero_pow]
    exact zero_add one

def Qubit.init (a b : Complex) : Qubit := normalize ⟨a, b⟩

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit := ⟨Complex.mk 1 0, Complex.mk 0 0⟩

theorem Qubit.initBasis0_norm : initBasis0.normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold initBasis0 normSquared Complex.magnitudeSquared
  simp only [Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re, pow_two, add_zero, zero_add]

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit := ⟨Complex.mk 0 0, Complex.mk 1 0⟩

theorem Qubit.initBasis1_norm : initBasis1.normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold initBasis1 normSquared Complex.magnitudeSquared
  simp only [Complex.one_re, Complex.zero_im, Complex.zero_re, pow_two, add_zero, zero_add]

def Qubit.prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ := max 0 (min 1 q.a.magnitudeSquared)

def Qubit.prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ := max 0 (min 1 q.b.magnitudeSquared)

theorem Qubit.prob0_nonneg (q : Qubit) : q.prob0 ≥ 0 := by
  unfold prob0; exact le_max_left 0 (min 1 q.a.magnitudeSquared)

theorem Qubit.prob1_nonneg (q : Qubit) : q.prob1 ≥ 0 := by
  unfold prob1; exact le_max_left 0 (min 1 q.b.magnitudeSquared)

theorem Qubit.prob0_le_one (q : Qubit) : q.prob0 ≤ 1 := by
  unfold prob0
  apply le_trans (le_max_right 0 _) (min_le_left 1 _)

theorem Qubit.prob1_le_one (q : Qubit) : q.prob1 ≤ 1 := by
  unfold prob1
  apply le_trans (le_max_right 0 _) (min_le_left 1 _)

def Gate := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let invSqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let s := Complex.mk invSqrt2 0
  let aNew := (q.a + q.b) * s
  let bNew := (q.a - q.b) * s
  Qubit.init aNew bNew

theorem hadamardGate_norm (q : Qubit) : (hadamardGate q).normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold hadamardGate
  unfold Qubit.init
  exact Qubit.normalize_normSquared_eq_one _

def pauliXGate : Gate := fun q => Qubit.init q.b q.a

theorem pauliXGate_norm (q : Qubit) : (pauliXGate q).normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold pauliXGate Qubit.init
  exact Qubit.normalize_normSquared_eq_one _

def pauliYGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let i := Complex.mk 0 1
  let minusI := Complex.mk 0 (-1)
  Qubit.init (minusI * q.b) (i * q.a)

theorem pauliYGate_norm (q : Qubit) : (pauliYGate q).normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold pauliYGate Qubit.init
  exact Qubit.normalize_normSquared_eq_one _

def pauliZGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let phase := Complex.mk (-1) 0
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b * phase)

theorem pauliZGate_norm (q : Qubit) : (pauliZGate q).normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold pauliZGate Qubit.init
  exact Qubit.normalize_normSquared_eq_one _

def identityGate : Gate := fun q => q

theorem identityGate_norm (q : Qubit) : (identityGate q).normSquared = q.normSquared := rfl

def phaseGate (p : ℝ) : Gate := fun q =>
  let c := Real.cos p
  let s := Real.sin p
  let e := Complex.mk c s
  Qubit.init q.a (q.b * e)

theorem phaseGate_norm (q : Qubit) (p : ℝ) : ((phaseGate p) q).normSquared = 1 := by
  unfold phaseGate Qubit.init
  exact Qubit.normalize_normSquared_eq_one _

structure EdgeKey where
  source : String

  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, BEq, Hashable

instance : Ord EdgeKey where
  compare k1 k2 :=
    match compare k1.source k2.source with
    | .lt => .lt
    | .gt => .gt
    | .eq => compare k1.target k2.target

instance EdgeKey.lt : LT EdgeKey := ltOfCompare
instance EdgeKey.le : LE EdgeKey := leOfCompare

instance (k1 k2 : EdgeKey) : Decidable (k1 < k2) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (compare k1 k2 = .lt))
instance (k1 k2 : EdgeKey) : Decidable (k1 ≤ k2) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (compare k1 k2 ≠ .gt))

def PairKey.canonical (x y : String) : PairKey :=

theorem PairKey.canonical_le (x y : String) : (canonical x y).a ≤ (canonical x y).b := by
  unfold canonical
  split <;> simp only [Fin.mk.injEq]
  exact String.le_of_ble.2 (by simp)
  exact String.le_of_ble.2 (by simp)

def TwoQubit := Vector Complex 4

def TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let is2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  Vector.mk #[Complex.mk is2 0, Complex.mk 0 0, Complex.mk 0 0, Complex.mk is2 0] (by decide)

theorem TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus_norm : (initBellPhiPlus.toList.map Complex.magnitudeSquared).sum = 1 := by
  unfold initBellPhiPlus
  simp only [Vector.mk_toList, List.map_map, List.sum_map_add]
  simp only [Complex.magnitudeSquared, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  simp only [Complex.mk_re, Complex.mk_im]
  simp only [Real.sqrt_mul, Real.sq_sqrt, add_zero, zero_add]
  have h : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 1 / 2 := by ring; field_simp; ring
  simp only [h, zero_add, add_zero, Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, pow_two]
  ring

def SRGraph.init : SRGraph :=
  { nodes := RBMap.empty, edges := RBMap.empty, entanglements := RBMap.empty, quantumRegister := RBMap.empty }

theorem SRGraph.init_node_empty : SRGraph.init.nodes = RBMap.empty := rfl

def SRGraph.nodeCount (g : SRGraph) : Nat := g.nodes.size

def SRGraph.edgeCount (g : SRGraph) : Nat :=
  g.edges.fold (fun acc _ es => acc + es.length) 0

theorem SRGraph.edgeCount_pos (g : SRGraph) : g.edgeCount ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le _

def SRGraph.addNode (g : SRGraph) (n : Node) : SRGraph :=
  let newNodes := g.nodes.insert n.id n
  let newQR := g.quantumRegister.insert n.id n.qubit
  { g with nodes := newNodes, quantumRegister := newQR }

theorem SRGraph.addNode_nodes (g : SRGraph) (n : Node) :
  (g.addNode n).nodes.find? n.id = some n := by
  unfold addNode
  simp only [RBMap.find?_insert]

theorem SRGraph.addNode_qr (g : SRGraph) (n : Node) :
  (g.addNode n).quantumRegister.find? n.id = some n.qubit := by

  simp only [RBMap.find?_insert]

theorem SRGraph.addNode_nodeCount (g : SRGraph) (n : Node) (h : g.nodes.find? n.id = none) :

  unfold nodeCount addNode
  rw [RBMap.size_insert_if_new]
  exact h

def SRGraph.addEdge (g : SRGraph) (src tgt : String) (e : Edge) : Option SRGraph :=
  if g.nodes.contains src ∧ g.nodes.contains tgt then
    let key : EdgeKey := ⟨src, tgt⟩
    let current := g.edges.findD key []
    let newEdges := g.edges.insert key (e :: current)
    some { g with edges := newEdges }
  else none

theorem SRGraph.addEdge_some (g : SRGraph) (src tgt : String) (e : Edge)
  (h : g.nodes.contains src ∧ g.nodes.contains tgt) :
  ∃ g', g.addEdge src tgt e = some g' := by
  unfold addEdge
  simp only [h, if_pos, Option.some_eq_some']

theorem SRGraph.addEdge_edge_added (g : SRGraph) (src tgt : String) (e : Edge)
  (h : g.nodes.contains src ∧ g.nodes.contains tgt) :
  match g.addEdge src tgt e with
  | some g' => g'.edges.find? ⟨src, tgt⟩ = some (e :: g.edges.findD ⟨src, tgt⟩ [])
  | none => True := by
  unfold addEdge
  rw [if_pos h]
  simp only [RBMap.find?_insert, RBMap.find?_findD]

def SRGraph.getNode (g : SRGraph) (id : String) : Option Node :=
  g.nodes.find? id

def SRGraph.getEdges (g : SRGraph) (src tgt : String) : List Edge :=
  g.edges.findD ⟨src, tgt⟩ []

def SRGraph.setQuantumState (g : SRGraph) (id : String) (q : Qubit) : Option SRGraph :=
  match g.nodes.find? id with
  | some n =>
    let n' := { n with qubit := q }
    let nodes' := g.nodes.insert id n'
    let qr' := g.quantumRegister.insert id q
    some { g with nodes := nodes', quantumRegister := qr' }
  | none => none

theorem SRGraph.setQuantumState_update (g : SRGraph) (id : String) (q : Qubit) (h : g.nodes.contains id) :
  match g.setQuantumState id q with
  | some g' => g'.quantumRegister.find? id = some q
  | none => False := by
  unfold setQuantumState
  rw [RBMap.find?_contains] at h
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn⟩
  simp only [Option.some_eq_some', hn]
  unfold SRGraph.quantumRegister
  simp only [RBMap.find?_insert]

def SRGraph.applyGate (g : SRGraph) (id : String) (gate : Gate) : Option SRGraph :=
  match g.nodes.find? id with
  | some n =>
    let newQ := gate n.qubit
    g.setQuantumState id newQ
  | none => none

theorem SRGraph.applyGate_update (g : SRGraph) (id : String) (gate : Gate) (h : g.nodes.contains id) :
  match g.applyGate id gate with
  | some g' => g'.quantumRegister.find? id = some (gate ((g.nodes.find? id).get h))
  | none => False := by
  unfold applyGate
  simp only [RBMap.find?_contains] at h
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn⟩
  simp only [hn, Option.some_get, Option.some_eq_some']
  exact setQuantumState_update _ _ _ ⟨n, hn⟩

def SRGraph.entangleNodes (g : SRGraph) (id1 id2 : String) : Option SRGraph :=
  if g.nodes.contains id1 ∧ g.nodes.contains id2 then
    let pk := PairKey.canonical id1 id2
    let ent := TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
    let ents' := g.entanglements.insert pk ent
    let g' := { g with entanglements := ents' }
    let e1 := Edge.init id1 id2 EdgeQuality.entangled 1 (Complex.mk 1 0) 0
    let e2 := Edge.init id2 id1 EdgeQuality.entangled 1 (Complex.mk 1 0) 0
    match g'.addEdge id1 id2 e1 with
    | some g'' => match g''.addEdge id2 id1 e2 with
      | some g''' => some g'''
      | none => none
    | none => none
  else none

theorem SRGraph.entangleNodes_add_edges (g : SRGraph) (id1 id2 : String)
  (h : g.nodes.contains id1 ∧ g.nodes.contains id2) :
  match g.entangleNodes id1 id2 with
  | some g' => g'.edges.contains ⟨id1, id2⟩ ∧ g'.edges.contains ⟨id2, id1⟩
  | none => False := by
  unfold entangleNodes
  rw [if_pos h]
  simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_eq_some]
  intro g' hg' g'' hg''
  simp only [RBMap.contains]
  rw [←RBMap.find?_contains] at hg' hg''
  cases hg' : g'.edges.find? ⟨id1, id2⟩
  case none => simp only [Option.mem_def] at hg'
  case some e =>
    rw [addEdge] at hg''
    simp only [h.1, h.2, and_self, if_pos, Option.some_eq_some'] at hg''
    rw [←RBMap.find?_contains]
    exact ⟨hg', by {
      rw [hg'']
      simp only [RBMap.find?_insert]
      exact ⟨rfl⟩
    }⟩

inductive MeasurementOutcome
| zero : MeasurementOutcome
| one : MeasurementOutcome
deriving Repr

def randomBitSeed (seed : Nat) : Bool := seed % 2 == 1

def SRGraph.measureNode (g : SRGraph) (id : String) (seed : Nat) : Option (MeasurementOutcome × SRGraph) :=
  match g.nodes.find? id with
  | none => none
  | some n =>
    let p0 := n.qubit.prob0
    let r := (seed % 1000000).toNat / 1000000.0
    let outcome := if r ≤ p0 then MeasurementOutcome.zero else MeasurementOutcome.one
    let newQ := match outcome with
                | .zero => Qubit.initBasis0
                | .one => Qubit.initBasis1
    match g.setQuantumState id newQ with
    | some g' => some (outcome, g')
    | none => none

theorem SRGraph.measureNode_collapse (g : SRGraph) (id : String) (seed : Nat) (h : g.nodes.contains id) :
  match g.measureNode id seed with
  | some (res, g') =>
    (res = .zero ∧ g'.quantumRegister.find? id = some Qubit.initBasis0) ∨
    (res = .one ∧ g'.quantumRegister.find? id = some Qubit.initBasis1)
  | none => False := by
  unfold measureNode
  simp only [RBMap.find?_contains] at h
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn⟩
  simp only [hn, Option.some_get, Option.some_eq_some']
  split
  next h =>
    simp only [Option.some_eq_some']
    left
    simp only [h, and_true]
    unfold setQuantumState
    simp only [hn, Option.some_eq_some']
    unfold quantumRegister
    simp only [RBMap.find?_insert]
  next h =>
    right
    simp only [h, and_true]
    unfold setQuantumState
    simp only [hn, Option.some_eq_some']
    unfold quantumRegister
    simp only [RBMap.find?_insert]

def hashString (s : String) : UInt64 :=
  s.foldl (fun acc c => acc * 31 + c.val.toUInt64) 0

def hashComplex (c : Complex) : UInt64 :=
  let r := hashFloat c.re
  let i := hashFloat c.im
  r + i * 17
where
  hashFloat (f : Float) : UInt64 :=
    if f == 0 then 0 else (f.toUInt64 <|> 0)

def hashList (l : List UInt64) : UInt64 :=
  l.foldl (fun acc h => acc ^^^ h + 17) 0

def SRGraph.topologyHashAux (g : SRGraph) : UInt64 :=
  let nHash := g.nodes.fold (fun acc _ n => acc + hashString n.id + hashComplex n.qubit.a + hashComplex n.qubit.b) 0
  let eHash := g.edges.fold (fun acc _ es => acc + (es.map (fun e => hashString e.source + hashString e.target)).sum) 0
  nHash ^^^ eHash

def SRGraph.topologyHash (g : SRGraph) : String :=
  (g.topologyHashAux).toString

theorem SRGraph.topologyHash_deterministic (g : SRGraph) : g.topologyHash = g.topologyHash := rfl

def SRGraph.encodeInformation (g : SRGraph) (data : String) (seed : Nat) : Option (String × SRGraph) :=
  let h := hashString data
  let id := s!"{h}"
  let q := if randomBitSeed seed then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
  let n := Node.init id data q 0
  let g' := g.addNode n
  some (id, g')

theorem SRGraph.encodeInformation_adds_node (g : SRGraph) (data : String) (seed : Nat) :
  match g.encodeInformation data seed with
  | some (id, g') => g'.nodes.contains id
  | none => False := by
  unfold encodeInformation
  simp only [Option.some_eq_some']
  unfold addNode nodes
  simp only [RBMap.contains, RBMap.find?_insert]
  exact ⟨rfl⟩

def SRGraph.decodeInformation (g : SRGraph) (id : String) : Option String :=
  match g.nodes.find? id with
  | some n => some n.data
  | none => none

theorem SRGraph.decodeInformation_matches_encode (g : SRGraph) (data : String) (seed : Nat) :
  match g.encodeInformation data seed with
  | some (id, g') => g'.decodeInformation id = some data
  | none => False := by
  unfold encodeInformation decodeInformation
  simp only [Option.some_eq_some']
  unfold addNode
  simp only [RBMap.find?_insert]
  unfold Node.init
  simp only [Option.some_eq_some']

const std = @import("std");

const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator;
const ArrayList = std.ArrayList;
const StringHashMap = std.StringHashMap;
const Sha256 = std.crypto.hash.sha2.Sha256;
const Complex = std.math.Complex;

pub const EdgeQuality = enum(u8) {
    superposition = 0,
    entangled = 1,
    coherent = 2,
    collapsed = 3,
    fractal = 4,

    pub fn toString(self: EdgeQuality) []const u8 {
        return switch (self) {
            .superposition => "superposition",
            .entangled => "entangled",
            .coherent => "coherent",
            .collapsed => "collapsed",
            .fractal => "fractal",
        };
    }

    pub fn fromString(s: []const u8) ?EdgeQuality {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, s, "superposition")) return .superposition;
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, s, "entangled")) return .entangled;
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, s, "coherent")) return .coherent;
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, s, "collapsed")) return .collapsed;
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, s, "fractal")) return .fractal;
        return null;
    }
};

fn dupeBytes(allocator: Allocator, b: []const u8) ![]u8 {
    return try allocator.dupe(u8, b);
}

fn freeMapStringBytes(map: *StringHashMap([]u8), allocator: Allocator) void {
    var it = map.iterator();
    while (it.next()) |e| {
        allocator.free(e.key_ptr.*);
        allocator.free(e.value_ptr.*);
    }
    map.deinit();
}

fn putOwnedStringBytes(map: *StringHashMap([]u8), allocator: Allocator, key: []const u8, value: []const u8) !void {
    if (map.fetchRemove(key)) |removed| {
        allocator.free(removed.key);
        allocator.free(removed.value);
    }
    const k = try allocator.dupe(u8, key);
    errdefer allocator.free(k);
    const v = try allocator.dupe(u8, value);
    errdefer allocator.free(v);
    map.put(k, v) catch |err| {
        allocator.free(k);
        allocator.free(v);
        return err;
    };
}

pub const Qubit = struct {
    a: Complex(f64),
    b: Complex(f64),

    pub fn init(a: Complex(f64), b: Complex(f64)) Qubit {
        var q = Qubit{ .a = a, .b = b };
        q.normalizeInPlace();
        return q;
    }

    pub fn initBasis0() Qubit {
        return Qubit{ .a = Complex(f64).init(1.0, 0.0), .b = Complex(f64).init(0.0, 0.0) };
    }

    pub fn initBasis1() Qubit {
        return Qubit{ .a = Complex(f64).init(0.0, 0.0), .b = Complex(f64).init(1.0, 0.0) };
    }

    pub fn normSquared(self: Qubit) f64 {
        return self.a.magnitudeSquared() + self.b.magnitudeSquared();
    }

    pub fn normalizeInPlace(self: *Qubit) void {
        const ns = self.normSquared();
        if (!(ns > 0.0) or std.math.isNan(ns) or std.math.isInf(ns)) {
            self.* = Qubit.initBasis0();
            return;
        }
        const inv = 1.0 / std.math.sqrt(ns);
        const s = Complex(f64).init(inv, 0.0);
        self.a = self.a.mul(s);
        self.b = self.b.mul(s);
    }

    pub fn prob0(self: Qubit) f64 {
        return std.math.clamp(self.a.magnitudeSquared(), 0.0, 1.0);
    }

    pub fn prob1(self: Qubit) f64 {
        return std.math.clamp(self.b.magnitudeSquared(), 0.0, 1.0);
    }
};

pub const Node = struct {
    id: []u8,
    data: []u8,
    qubit: Qubit,
    phase: f64,
    metadata: StringHashMap([]u8),
    allocator: Allocator,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, id: []const u8, data: []const u8, qubit: Qubit, phase: f64) !Node {
        return Node{
            .id = try dupeBytes(allocator, id),
            .data = try dupeBytes(allocator, data),
            .qubit = qubit,
            .phase = phase,
            .metadata = StringHashMap([]u8).init(allocator),
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *Node) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.id);
        self.allocator.free(self.data);
        freeMapStringBytes(&self.metadata, self.allocator);
    }

    pub fn clone(self: *const Node, allocator: Allocator) !Node {
        var n = Node{
            .id = try dupeBytes(allocator, self.id),
            .data = try dupeBytes(allocator, self.data),
            .qubit = self.qubit,
            .phase = self.phase,

pub const EdgeKey = struct {
    source: []const u8,
    target: []const u8,
};

fn hashSlice(h: *std.hash.Wyhash, s: []const u8) void {
    var len_buf: [8]u8 = undefined;
    std.mem.writeInt(u64, &len_buf, @as(u64, @intCast(s.len)), .little);
    h.update(&len_buf);
    h.update(s);
}

pub const EdgeKeyContext = struct {
    pub fn hash(_: @This(), k: EdgeKey) u64 {
        var h = std.hash.Wyhash.init(0);
        hashSlice(&h, k.source);
        hashSlice(&h, k.target);
        return h.final();
    }

    pub fn eql(_: @This(), a: EdgeKey, b: EdgeKey) bool {
        return std.mem.eql(u8, a.source, b.source) and std.mem.eql(u8, a.target, b.target);
    }
};

pub const PairKey = struct {
    a: []const u8,
    b: []const u8,
};

pub const PairKeyContext = struct {
    pub fn hash(_: @This(), k: PairKey) u64 {
        var h = std.hash.Wyhash.init(1);
        hashSlice(&h, k.a);
        hashSlice(&h, k.b);
        return h.final();
    }

    pub fn eql(_: @This(), x: PairKey, y: PairKey) bool {
        return std.mem.eql(u8, x.a, y.a) and std.mem.eql(u8, x.b, y.b);
    }
};

pub const TwoQubit = struct {
    amps: [4]Complex(f64),

    pub fn initBellPhiPlus() TwoQubit {
        const inv_sqrt2 = 1.0 / std.math.sqrt(2.0);
        return TwoQubit{
            .amps = .{
                Complex(f64).init(inv_sqrt2, 0.0),
                Complex(f64).init(0.0, 0.0),
                Complex(f64).init(0.0, 0.0),
                Complex(f64).init(inv_sqrt2, 0.0),
            },
        };
    }
};

pub const Gate = fn (q: Qubit) Qubit;

pub fn hadamardGate(q: Qubit) Qubit {
    const inv_sqrt2 = 1.0 / std.math.sqrt(2.0);
    const s = Complex(f64).init(inv_sqrt2, 0.0);
    const a = q.a.add(q.b).mul(s);
    const b = q.a.sub(q.b).mul(s);
    return Qubit.init(a, b);
}

pub fn pauliXGate(q: Qubit) Qubit {
    return Qubit.init(q.b, q.a);
}

pub fn pauliYGate(q: Qubit) Qubit {
    const i = Complex(f64).init(0.0, 1.0);
    const minus_i = Complex(f64).init(0.0, -1.0);
    return Qubit.init(minus_i.mul(q.b), i.mul(q.a));
}

pub fn pauliZGate(q: Qubit) Qubit {
    return Qubit.init(q.a, q.b.mul(Complex(f64).init(-1.0, 0.0)));
}

pub fn identityGate(q: Qubit) Qubit {
    return q;
}

pub fn phaseGate(phase: f64) Gate {
    const c = std.math.cos(phase);
    const s = std.math.sin(phase);
    const e = Complex(f64).init(c, s);
    return struct {
        const factor = e;
        pub fn f(q: Qubit) Qubit {
            return Qubit.init(q.a, q.b.mul(factor));
        }
    }.f;
}

fn floatBits(v: f64) u64 {
    return @as(u64, @bitCast(v));
}

fn shaUpdateU64(h: *Sha256, v: u64) void {
    var b: [8]u8 = undefined;
    std.mem.writeInt(u64, &b, v, .little);
    h.update(&b);
}

fn shaUpdateBytes(h: *Sha256, b: []const u8) void {
    shaUpdateU64(h, @as(u64, @intCast(b.len)));
    h.update(b);
}

fn shaUpdateF64(h: *Sha256, v: f64) void {
    shaUpdateU64(h, floatBits(v));
}

fn xorDigest(acc: *[Sha256.digest_length]u8, d: *const [Sha256.digest_length]u8) void {
    for (acc, 0..) |_, i| acc[i] ^= d[i];
}

const EdgeMap = std.HashMap(EdgeKey, ArrayList(Edge), EdgeKeyContext, std.hash_map.default_max_load_percentage);
const EntMap = std.HashMap(PairKey, TwoQubit, PairKeyContext, std.hash_map.default_max_load_percentage);

pub const SelfSimilarRelationalGraph = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    nodes: StringHashMap(Node),
    edges: EdgeMap,
    entanglements: EntMap,
    quantum_register: StringHashMap(Qubit),
    topology_hash: [65]u8,
    rng: std.rand.DefaultPrng,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator) !SelfSimilarRelationalGraph {
        const ts = std.time.nanoTimestamp();
        const seed: u64 = std.hash.Wyhash.hash(0, std.mem.asBytes(&ts));
        var g = SelfSimilarRelationalGraph{
            .allocator = allocator,
            .nodes = StringHashMap(Node).init(allocator),
            .edges = EdgeMap.init(allocator),
            .entanglements = EntMap.init(allocator),
            .quantum_register = StringHashMap(Qubit).init(allocator),
            .topology_hash = [_]u8{0} ** 65,
            .rng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(seed),
        };
        try g.updateTopologyHash();
        return g;
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) void {
        var n_it = self.nodes.iterator();
        while (n_it.next()) |e| e.value_ptr.deinit();
        self.nodes.deinit();

        var ed_it = self.edges.iterator();
        while (ed_it.next()) |e| {
            for (e.value_ptr.items) |*edge| edge.deinit();
            e.value_ptr.deinit();
        }
        self.edges.deinit();

        self.entanglements.deinit();

        var qr_it = self.quantum_register.iterator();
        while (qr_it.next()) |e| self.allocator.free(e.key_ptr.*);
        self.quantum_register.deinit();
    }

    fn canonicalIdPtr(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, id: []const u8) ?[]const u8 {
        if (self.nodes.getPtr(id)) |n| return n.id;
        return null;
    }

    pub fn addNode(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, node_in: Node) !void {
        var node = node_in;
        const incoming_id = node.id;

        if (self.nodes.getPtr(incoming_id)) |existing| {
            self.allocator.free(existing.data);
            existing.data = try dupeBytes(self.allocator, node.data);
            existing.qubit = node.qubit;
            existing.phase = node.phase;

            freeMapStringBytes(&existing.metadata, self.allocator);
            existing.metadata = StringHashMap([]u8).init(self.allocator);

            var it = node.metadata.iterator();
            while (it.next()) |m| {
                const k = try dupeBytes(self.allocator, m.key_ptr.*);
                const v = try dupeBytes(self.allocator, m.value_ptr.*);
                existing.metadata.put(k, v) catch |err| {
                    self.allocator.free(k);
                    self.allocator.free(v);
                    return err;
                };
            }

            node.deinit();
        } else {
            try self.nodes.put(node.id, node);
        }

        if (self.quantum_register.fetchRemove(incoming_id)) |removed| self.allocator.free(removed.key);
        const qr_key = try dupeBytes(self.allocator, incoming_id);
        errdefer self.allocator.free(qr_key);
        const q = self.nodes.get(incoming_id).?.qubit;
        try self.quantum_register.put(qr_key, q);

        try self.updateTopologyHash();
    }

    pub fn addEdge(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, source: []const u8, target: []const u8, edge_in: Edge) !void {
        const s = self.canonicalIdPtr(source) orelse return error.SourceNodeNotFound;
        const t = self.canonicalIdPtr(target) orelse return error.TargetNodeNotFound;

        var edge = edge_in;
        defer edge.deinit();

        var stored = try edge.clone(self.allocator);
        stored.source = s;
        stored.target = t;

        const key = EdgeKey{ .source = s, .target = t };
        var gop = try self.edges.getOrPut(key);
        if (!gop.found_existing) gop.value_ptr.* = ArrayList(Edge).init(self.allocator);

        gop.value_ptr.append(stored) catch |err| {
            stored.deinit();
            if (!gop.found_existing and gop.value_ptr.items.len == 0) {
                gop.value_ptr.deinit();
                _ = self.edges.remove(key);
            }
            return err;
        };

        try self.updateTopologyHash();
    }

    pub fn getNodeConst(self: *const SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, node_id: []const u8) ?*const Node {
        return self.nodes.getPtr(node_id);
    }

    pub fn getEdgesConst(self: *const SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, source: []const u8, target: []const u8) ?[]const Edge {
        const key = EdgeKey{ .source = source, .target = target };
        if (self.edges.getPtr(key)) |list| return list.items;
        return null;
    }

    pub fn clear(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) !void {
        var n_it = self.nodes.iterator();
        while (n_it.next()) |e| e.value_ptr.deinit();
        self.nodes.clearRetainingCapacity();

        var ed_it = self.edges.iterator();
        while (ed_it.next()) |e| {
            for (e.value_ptr.items) |*edge| edge.deinit();
            e.value_ptr.deinit();
        }
        self.edges.clearRetainingCapacity();

        self.entanglements.clearRetainingCapacity();

        var qr_it = self.quantum_register.iterator();
        while (qr_it.next()) |e| self.allocator.free(e.key_ptr.*);
        self.quantum_register.clearRetainingCapacity();

        try self.updateTopologyHash();
    }

    pub fn setQuantumState(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, node_id: []const u8, q: Qubit) !void {
        const n = self.nodes.getPtr(node_id) orelse return error.NodeNotFound;
        n.qubit = q;

        if (self.quantum_register.getPtr(node_id)) |qptr| {
            qptr.* = q;
        } else {
            const k = try dupeBytes(self.allocator, node_id);
            errdefer self.allocator.free(k);
            try self.quantum_register.put(k, q);
        }

        try self.updateTopologyHash();
    }

    pub fn getQuantumState(self: *const SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, node_id: []const u8) ?Qubit {
        return self.quantum_register.get(node_id);
    }

    pub fn applyQuantumGate(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, node_id: []const u8, gate: Gate) !void {
        const n = self.nodes.getPtr(node_id) orelse return error.NodeNotFound;
        n.qubit = gate(n.qubit);
        if (self.quantum_register.getPtr(node_id)) |qptr| qptr.* = n.qubit;
        try self.updateTopologyHash();
    }

    pub fn entangleNodes(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, a_id: []const u8, b_id: []const u8) !void {
        const a = self.canonicalIdPtr(a_id) orelse return error.NodeNotFound;
        const b = self.canonicalIdPtr(b_id) orelse return error.NodeNotFound;

        const pk = if (std.mem.lessThan(u8, a, b)) PairKey{ .a = a, .b = b } else PairKey{ .a = b, .b = a };
        try self.entanglements.put(pk, TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus());

        const edge_ab = Edge.init(self.allocator, a, b, .entangled, 1.0, Complex(f64).init(1.0, 0.0), 0.0);
        const edge_ba = Edge.init(self.allocator, b, a, .entangled, 1.0, Complex(f64).init(1.0, 0.0), 0.0);
        try self.addEdge(a, b, edge_ab);
        try self.addEdge(b, a, edge_ba);
    }

    pub fn measure(self: *SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, node_id: []const u8) !u1 {
        _ = self.canonicalIdPtr(node_id) orelse return error.NodeNotFound;

        var hit_key: ?PairKey = null;
        var hit_val: ?TwoQubit = null;

        var it = self.entanglements.iterator();
        while (it.next()) |e| {

                hit_key = e.key_ptr.*;
                hit_val = e.value_ptr.*;
                break;

                0 => { a_ptr.qubit = Qubit.initBasis0(); b_ptr.qubit = Qubit.initBasis0(); },
